description: This file defines a 'ProductCard' component using the LightningJS framework. It manages visual presentation and interaction logic for a product card in a furniture shopping front-end, including layout, state handling, and event responses.

classes.name: ProductCard
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing a product display card in the shopping application.

methods.name: enter
methods.description: Handles navigation when the product card is activated, routing to the product detail page.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event, updates visual state to indicate hover and interaction.

methods.name: onUnfocus
methods.description: Handles loss of focus, resets visual state.
